notes:
Account snapshot: Lodestar is a mid-market B2B productivity suite (project management + knowledge base). Looking to add in-product assistant and smarter search. Initial interest started Q4 2025 around embeddings + a chat assistant for task creation. Shortlist: Redwood (hosted -> dedicated), OpenAI (managed), and a self-host option for specific workloads.

Engagement summary (shorthand):
- 2025-11-20: Intro call w/ Marisol; product team -> use-case mapping, latency target ~ <200ms tail for chat, 100ms median for short prompts.
- 2025-12-08: Hosted API demo (ff_2026-02-22_lodestar-demo referenced), basic POC approved by product.
- 2026-01-15: Pricing discussion; asked for committed throughput pricing vs pay-as-you-go.
- 2026-02-10: POC kickoff (embeddings + semantic search). POC dataset ~ 250k docs (knowledge base).
- 2026-02-22: Full demo + architecture walkthrough. SE (Diego) covered batching and KV cache; product liked automatic caching suggestions.
- 2026-03-01: Security sync w/ Lodestar infosec (ff_2026-03-01_security-sync). They requested SOC2 evidence, SSO/SAML integration pattern, audit log retention policy, and encryption/KMS details.

Requirements / constraints:
- Workloads: mix of embeddings for search (~200 qps peak) and chat assistant for in-app actions (~50 qps peak). Need deterministic tail latency for chat (SLO target 99th <350ms).
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market price bands. They want a Dedicated plan that yields predictable unit cost at committed throughput.
- Model: prefer open model variants (cost) but need Redwood to support fallback to smaller model for non-critical routes.
- Routing/fallback: must support region-aware routing (US primary, EU for EU customers) and automatic fallback to cheaper instance if Dedicated capacity constrained.

Security expectations (from Lodestar infosec):
- SOC2 type II report and control mapping + timeline for SOC2 audit if not current.
- SSO/SAML integration + IdP metadata exchange process.
- Audit logs: request per-request logs with token-level redaction and 1 year retention for security team; ability to export logs to their SIEM (Splunk).
- Retention controls: retention-at-source and purge APIs; ability to disable retention for PII content.
- KMS integration: customer-managed keys (bring-your-own) preferred for Dedicated; clarify key rotation and HSM options.
- Network: VPC peering for Dedicated, subnet/IP planning; need diagram + expected maintenance window SLAs.

POC / Evaluation notes:
- POC currently running on Hosted with sample of KB; initial embeddings quality acceptable. Long pole is security sign-off for Dedicated/VPC before procurement can close.
- SE tasks: provide explicit dedicated network diagram, SOC2 artifact bundle, SAML SSO integration playbook, log export example to Splunk.
- Pricing ask: committed monthly throughput with overage cap; Lodestar asked for 12-month and 24-month committed tiers.
